name: Craig Heffner
biography: experience in IT security includes system and network analysis, wireless and networking security and vulnerability discovery, and he is currently employed as a Senior Security Engineer for Seismic LLC. He frequently publishes various tools, papers and vulnerability reports, and has a special fondness for embedded devices, particularly any whose descriptions include the words "wireless" or "Web based administrative interface".
